subject: Retained output rights — execution plan & evidence request
messages:
From: Tom Reyes <tom.reyes@edgewave.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: EdgeWave Procurement <procurement@edgewave.com>
Date: Sun, 4 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Proposed redlines to MSA — output ownership and training use

Hannah,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Procurement asked us to surface a couple of principal edits on the MSA/order form before we proceed:

- EdgeWave requests assignment of all "Product Output" (defined) for productization purposes (exclusive).
- We also want a limited right to use customer-generated prompts/output to improve our internal models.

Attached is a marked PDF with the baseline edits (EdgeWave_Edits_MSA_redline.pdf). Can you confirm whether Redwood can accept assignment or whether you prefer a license carveout? Also: we need a short list of operational evidence you can provide to show telemetry/retention limits for compliance.

Best,
Tom
Tom Reyes
Head of Procurement, EdgeWave Inc.
Attachment: EdgeWave_Edits_MSA_redline.pdf (PDF, 412 KB)

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Reyes <tom.reyes@edgewave.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 4 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposed redlines to MSA — output ownership and training use

Tom — appreciate the clear asks and the redline. Quick summary of Redwood's starting position:

- We do not assign model or training rights for output. We can offer an exclusive commercial use license for specific Product Output scoped in the order form, but assignment of IP would be a non-starter operationally (retracts the platform guarantees).
- We can offer an explicit opt-out for training/telemetry and limit retention windows for customer-specific data, with an audit/evidence package.

Laura and Ben are looping in legal/ops to propose precise language and an evidence checklist. Can we schedule a 30-minute sync Tuesday 4/6 10:00 AM PT to walk the carveout and the evidence package?

Thanks,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Director, Commercial Contracts | Redwood Inference
Attachment: n/a

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>

Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 4 Apr 2027 13:46:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Proposed redlines to MSA — output ownership and training use

Hannah / team — I reviewed EdgeWave's redline and drafted an annotated response (Redwood_response_redline.docx). Key negotiation points to present on Tuesday: 

1) Output assignment vs license
- We propose a narrow, exclusive license to the defined Product Output limited to the specific product(s) ordered, with a mutual representation that Redwood retains the underlying model, weights, and engineering IP.

2) Training/data use
- We can offer a training opt-out for customer data with a default retention window of 30 days for logs (non-PHI) and a separate telemetry bucket used for platform health (aggregated, anonymized).
- If EdgeWave requires longer evidence retention for audits, we can offer a negotiated evidence retention addendum (timeboxed).

3) Feedback & improvements
- We are willing to grant a limited feedback license: non-exclusive, royalty-free, for internal model improvements, but explicitly excluding assignment and redistribution of customer Product Output as training datasets.

4) Proof points / evidence
Please ask them to confirm what their compliance team needs; suggested list below for our call:
- Sample telemetry extract showing retention timestamps
- Policy excerpt for anonymization/PII handling
- A signed attestation of deletion/opt-out controls after the retention window

I'll bring the redline. Ben, please prepare a short ops note showing how telemetry is segmented by tenant and how we can produce a timeboxed evidence snapshot (sample queries). Rishi, FYI in case legal wants to loop in privacy counsel.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
Attachment: Redwood_response_redline.docx (Word, 88 KB)

From: Samantha Park <samantha.park@edgewave.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 08:55:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposed redlines to MSA — output ownership and training use

Hannah / Laura — thanks for the early feedback and the draft doc. A few counterpoints from EdgeWave counsel:

- EdgeWave prefers assignment language for Product Output because their downstream partners require clear title for certain integrations. If Redwood cannot assign, EdgeWave will insist on a very broad exclusive license that is perpetual and transferrable.
- On training: a simple opt-out is fine, but EdgeWave needs an auditable deletion proof and a certified export of any customer-specific artifacts used for model improvement.

We can discuss carveouts (e.g., exclude diagnostic telemetry entirely from training), but that will need to be explicit. For the call, we will have procurement and legal on.

Samantha Park
Senior Counsel, EdgeWave Inc.
Attachment: EdgeWave_compliance_request.pdf (PDF, 56 KB)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 10:12:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Proposed redlines to MSA — output ownership and training use

Adding a short ops/engineering perspective for tomorrow's call:

- Telemetry segmentation: we store tenant logs in a per-tenant S3 namespace with tags; we can generate a timeboxed export (CSV) with event IDs and UTC timestamps.
- Deletion / audit trail: delete operations are soft-delete plus a final purge; we can provide an export and deletion log for a window (e.g., 90 days).
- Practical constraint: full assignment makes it hard to enforce upstream model updates (we need to retain rights to fix security/quality issues). Proposal: exclusive license for Product Output for commercial use + Redwood retains a right to modify/patch outputs for safety; no training assignment.

I'll bring the sample CLI commands and an ops checklist (Telemetry_evidence_checklist.xlsx) to the call.

Ben Carter
Head of Product Ops, Redwood Inference
Attachment: Telemetry_evidence_checklist.xlsx (Excel, 24 KB)

Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 6 Apr 2027 15:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposed redlines to MSA — output ownership and training use — Follow-up & action items

Thanks all for the call. Recap and agreed action items (for the record):

1) Commercial outcome
- Redwood will not assign model weights or underlying IP. We agreed to propose an exclusive, field-limited license for Product Output scoped to the Order Form, transferrable only with prior Redwood consent. EdgeWave will provide a use-case annex describing downstream partner requirements.

2) Training/telemetry
- EdgeWave accepted a firm training opt-out for customer prompts/output. Redwood will produce an auditable export for any tenant data used in model improvements and a deletion attestation for the negotiated retention window.

3) Evidence package and timeline
- Ben will share the Telemetry_evidence_checklist.xlsx by EOD Wednesday (4/7).
- Laura to produce a redline with the license language and an evidence addendum by Friday (4/9).
- EdgeWave (Samantha/Tom) to confirm if the license needs to be perpetual/transferable or if a narrower field-limited grant suffices; they will send a short use-case annex by Friday (4/9).

4) Next steps
- Draft to legal for review after Laura's redline. If both sides agree on license scope and evidence terms, we will push a final order form for signatures the week of 4/12.

Open item: exact verbiage for "exclusive" vs "exclusive for the product in the order form" — Laura to propose wording that preserves Redwood's ability to remediate/patch outputs for safety and security.

Thanks everyone — call notes and attachments are in the thread.

Hannah Schmitt
Director, Commercial Contracts | Redwood Inference
Attachment: call_notes_20270406.txt (text, 3 KB)
